WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    orders.status AS "orders.status"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    orders.status
), _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum AS (
  SELECT
    _base."customers.orders.status" AS "customers.orders.status",
    CAST(SUM(_base._v) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.credit_sum_host"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      orders.status AS "customers.orders.status",
      customers.customer_pk AS _ek0,
      MAX(customers.credit) AS _v
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON customers.customer_pk = orders.cust_fk
    WHERE
      NOT customers.customer_pk IS NULL AND NOT orders.cust_fk IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      orders.status,
      customers.customer_pk
  ) AS _base
  GROUP BY
    _base."customers.orders.status"
)
SELECT
  _base."orders.status",
  _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum."customers.credit_sum_host" AS "orders.cr"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum
  ON _base."orders.status" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__credit_sum."customers.orders.status"
